name: PullRequestCreate
description: Opens a pull request from a pushed branch. Give issue when the pull request resolves an issue, so that the forge links them. The forge refuses a second open pull request for the same head and base, and a pull request that already exists at the given head commit completes the call without a request.
title: Open a pull request from {input.head} into {input.base}

headSha.description: The commit the head branch is expected to be at

issue.description: The issue this pull request resolves; the body then ends with Closes #<issue>, which links the two

remote.description: The remote whose forge is asked; origin when left out

report: Pull request #{after.existing.number} is open for {input.head} into {input.base}: {after.existing.url}
